diaries.title: PAINTING: THE RIGHT PROCESS
diaries.content:
Ever experienced cracks in the middle of the wall giving your home a lack of luxury vibe? Not every time can the civil work be blamed for it. If the right painting process is not followed, cracks are bound to appear. Then what is the process would be a logical next question, which I have answered in this Blog.

STEP 1 - A thorough checking of the civil work to identify any major bumps in the plaster done. Major bumps cannot be hidden in putty and they are more highlighted, if the paint used is luxurious and has a high sheen.

STEP 2 - Application of a thin layer of branded putty (Asian Paints or Birla). Remember the layer must be thin to avoid cracks in the future. Cracks appear if the layer is thick. This layer of Putty is done to cover the gaps and the holes of the plaster done on walls.

STEP 3 - Application of a second layer of putty to even out the surface. After this coat dries, the wall is buffed with a sanding paper to make it smooth. Here comes a very important QC parameter of light checking. If the tube light is taken near the wall, all the undulations are evidently visible to understand the quality of work. If this step is passed then the finishing can be started.

STEP 4 - A coat of Asian Paint primer is done over the wall. This acts as an adhesive for the paint

STEP 5 - Two coats of luxury emulsion is done to get that luxe finish on the walls.

Walls live with you and that makes it more important for the walls to be taken care as any other member of the family.
